answer_1.quote: we propose to reason about event semantic relations as a reading comprehension / question answering task.
answer_1.outputs: natural language answers in the form of complete text spans

answer_2.quote: We evaluate this by using token-based F1 and exact-match measures. ... We measure this by HIT@1 scores.

answer_4.quote: To show the human performance on the task, we randomly select 20 questions for each semantic type from the test set. Two co-authors provide answers for these questions, and we compare their mutually agreed answers with the original answers.
answer_4.guideline: Two co-authors provide answers and compare with original answers.
